**General Purpose**
The Software Engineer – CET develops and maintains digital product content and software extensions for CET Designer, supporting the specification and visualization of MillerKnoll products. This role combines software engineering with product configuration, 3D visualization, and business logic to create intelligent digital representations of commercial furniture products.
  
  
Working as part of a cross-functional Agile team, the Software Engineer partners with Digital Product Management, QA, and Delivery Management to deliver new product introductions, enhancements, and ongoing platform improvements.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, test, and maintain CET software extensions using object-oriented programming principles.
* Develop configurable product logic supporting visualization, specification, pricing, bill of materials, and manufacturing rules.
* Create and maintain intelligent 2D and 3D product representations.
* Translate business and product requirements into scalable, maintainable software solutions.
* Participate in Agile development activities including planning, estimation, code reviews, testing, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams across North America, Europe, and Asia to support product launches and enhancements.
* Troubleshoot software defects and implement quality improvements.
* Contribute to engineering standards, development practices, and technical documentation.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline OR equivalent experience.
* Minimum of four (4) years of professional experience developing software using object-oriented programming languages such as C#, C++, Java, or similar technologies.

**Skills & Abilities**

* Strong understanding of object-oriented design principles, software architecture, and modern software development practices.
* Experience with source control systems and Agile development methodologies.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Experience developing applications or extensions for CET Designer (Configura) preferred.
* Experience developing CAD, 3D visualization, or product configuration applications preferred
* Knowledge of commercial furniture, manufacturing, or engineering systems preferred
* Experience working with globally distributed development teams. preferred

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a
 **Machine Learning Intern (Manipulation)** 
 to help build Persona's machine learning models and infrastructure. We are primarily interested in candidates with experience and relevant projects in robot learning, but can be flexible depending on aptitude and energy.
   

  

 As a Machine Learning Intern at Persona, you will have an incredible opportunity to work with humanoid robots and solve practical problems in the real world.

* Work with the ML team to develop and improve machine learning models and the infrastructure.

* Courage and grit to tackle some of the hardest problems in embodied AI.
* Enthusiasm for working collaboratively in a high paced team environment.
* Experience with deep learning frameworks (Pytorch, JAX, TensorFlow, etc.)
* Experience with cloud computing to develop models, manage data, etc. (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Strong understanding of the state of the art research in robot learning (behavior cloning and reinforcement learning for manipulation, world models, etc.).

* Capable of writing high\-quality software.
* Thrive in fast\-paced and ambiguous environments.
* Strong first principles thinker.

* Published papers at top ML/Robotics conferences (ICML, ICRA, CoRL, RSS, NeurIPS).

**General Summary**

Qualcomm’s AI Infrastructure Software team is seeking a highly motivated and versatile software engineer to develop cutting-edge embedded software across the full system stack on Qualcomm Snapdragon® processors. In this role, you will design, develop, and optimize core software frameworks that power next-generation AI and compute workloads across a broad range of applications, including machine learning inferencing, computer vision, virtual/augmented reality, image and video processing, automotive systems, IoT, sensors, audio, and more.
  
  
You will work on challenging low-level software problems involving inter-processor communication, memory management, execution environments, concurrency management, and DSP acceleration frameworks. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to technologies that enable high-performance, power-efficient computing on industry-leading Snapdragon platforms.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement embedded system software across multiple layers of the software stack.
* Develop and optimize inter-processor communication (IPC) and memory management solutions.
* Build software frameworks that enable efficient DSP acceleration for AI and multimedia workloads.
* Debug, profile, and optimize system performance across diverse hardware and software environments.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, high-performance solutions for Snapdragon-based products.

**Join Qualcomm's AI Infrastructure team and help shape the software foundation powering the future of intelligent computing on Snapdragon platforms.**
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
* Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as C, C++, Java, or Python.
* Solid understanding of computer architecture, operating systems, and embedded systems concepts.
* Knowledge of real-time operating systems (RTOS) and concurrent software design.
* Experience with software debugging, performance analysis, and system optimization techniques.
* Familiarity with multimedia, compute, and driver frameworks on Linux, Android, or Windows platforms.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently and drive technical solutions.

**Preferred Attributes**

* Passion for learning new technologies, architectures, and operating systems.
* Experience developing software for multicore or heterogeneous processing environments.
* Interest in AI/ML acceleration, DSP technologies, and high-performance embedded computing.
* Self-starter with excellent collaboration and communication skills who thrives in a fast-paced engineering environment.
